# Portland State University Library

> PSU Library provides comprehensive research resources, academic databases, institutional repository access, and reference support for Portland State University students and faculty.

Portland State University Library serves as the central hub for scholarly research and information access at PSU. The library offers extensive digital collections, special archives including Dark Horse Comics, and personalized research assistance through multiple service channels.

## Key Topics

- Portland State University
- Research guides
- Academic databases
- eBooks and digital resources
- Reference support

## Research Resources & Collections

- [Databases & Articles](https://guides.library.pdx.edu/az.php): A-Z directory of academic databases and research resources
- [PDXScholar: The Institutional Repository of Portland State University](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu): PSU institutional repository for scholarly works and open access materials
- [eBooks - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/research/ebooks): Guide to accessing and searching library eBook collections
- [Dictionaries - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/research/dictionaries): Reference guide to Oxford and other dictionary resources

## Library Services & Support

- [Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu): PSU Library homepage with mission, services, and research resources
- [Ask a Librarian - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/services/ask-a-librarian): Reference support via chat, email, text, and in-person consultation
- [Hours - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/about/hours): Library operating hours for main facility and service desks

## Special Collections

- [Dark Horse Comics - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/research/dark-horse-comics): Special collections guide to Dark Horse Comics archive

## Optional

- [Giving Opportunities - Portland State University Library](https://library.pdx.edu/about/giving-opportunities): Donation and fundraising opportunities for library support
